item.title: The relationship between officer misconduct and convictionless arrests
item.description:
Authors: Ba et al.
Journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

This paper examines whether officers with high prior alleged misconduct are more likely to make convictionless arrests (arrests that result in no or dismissed charges or where the defendant is found not guilty).
